plan.title: SHG Loan Portfolio & Repayment Performance
plan.subtitle: Analysis of loan disbursements, repayment recovery rates, purpose distribution, and overdue exposures across blocks

panels.title: Total Loans Disbursed
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT("Loan ID") AS total_loans FROM "shg_loan_register"

panels.title: Overall Recovery Rate
panels.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM("Amount Repaid (Rs)") * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)"), 0), 1) AS recovery_rate FROM "shg_loan_register"

panels.title: Overdue Loan Count
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS overdue_count FROM "shg_loan_register" WHERE "Repayment Status" = 'Overdue'

panels.title: Overdue Principal Amount
panels.sql: SELECT SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS overdue_amount FROM "shg_loan_register" WHERE "Repayment Status" = 'Overdue'

panels.title: Loans by Purpose
panels.sql: SELECT "Purpose" AS purpose, SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS total_amount FROM "shg_loan_register" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Disbursement and Repayment by Block
panels.sql: SELECT "Block" AS block, SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS disbursed, SUM("Amount Repaid (Rs)") AS repaid FROM "shg_loan_register" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY disbursed DESC

panels.title: Block-wise Repayment Status & Overdue Breakdown
panels.sql: SELECT "Block" AS block, COUNT("Loan ID") AS total_loans, SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS total_disbursed, SUM("Amount Repaid (Rs)") AS total_repaid, ROUND(SUM("Amount Repaid (Rs)") * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)"), 0), 1) AS recovery_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN "Repayment Status" = 'Overdue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_loans, SUM(CASE WHEN "Repayment Status" = 'Overdue' THEN "Loan Amount (Rs)" ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_principal FROM "shg_loan_register" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total_disbursed DESC

plan.narrative:
Across the operational blocks, a total of {{p1}} SHG loans have been issued. The overall portfolio exhibits an aggregate recovery rate of {{p2}}%, reflecting steady repayments alongside outstanding obligations.

However, portfolio quality requires monitoring, with {{p3}} accounts currently categorized as overdue, representing an aggregate principal at risk of Rs {{p4}}. Loan utilization spans multiple sectors including agriculture, livestock, petty trade, and family welfare, with regional variations evident across blocks.
